_meta.purpose: Breaks in a published series that a comparison must not span. A reading whose window crosses a break on a marked line is absent with the break's reason. Read by core/series_breaks.py only.
_meta.purpose_restatements: restatements: a line RBI reprinted on a new classification for only some months. Its months are read from the consolidated CSV; a comparison with exactly one date on them is absent.

breaks.source: RBI SIBC releases Feb-Jul 2025, notes: "Data since July 28, 2023 include the impact of the merger of a non-bank with a bank. Figures in parentheses exclude the impact of the merger."
breaks.lines_rule: The rows RBI prints merger-excluded figures for, identical in all six releases whose comparisons span the merger (PR2276SIBC28022025 ... PR815SIBC31072025).

restatements.source: RBI SIBC release of 30 Oct 2026 (SIBC30102026E.xlsx) reprints these lines for Sep 2024, Mar 2025, Sep 2025 and Mar 2026 well away from their earlier prints. RBI's notes give no reason; a reclassification from Transport Operators into Vehicle Loans is our reading of the arithmetic, not RBI's statement.
restatements.lines_rule: core/series_breaks.is_restatement: every reprinted month moved the same way, each by more than 3x the line's typical monthly change.
